set.body: Outcome: coherent crate names and boundaries, lean source tree, accurate metadata and licenses, preserved scientific evidence, verified public entry points. Scope: reversible local cleanup; no remote creation, push, registry release or history rewrite. Acceptance: locked Cargo metadata, default/all-feature tests, fmt and applicable Clippy; package file inventories; source/evidence preservation receipts. Preserve existing scientific behavior and per-crate licenses.
set.title: Prepare crate naming and repository hygiene for first GitHub push
